label: California Collection System Maintenance, Grade 1 (CWEA)
purpose: Practice questions for the California Water Environment Association (CWEA) Collection System Maintenance Grade 1 certification. Original items in US units. Not an official exam blueprint.
reviewIntro: 250 original practice questions: 210 conceptual and 40 calculations, in US customary units, following the six domains of the CWEA CSM Grade 1 outline (operations and maintenance 28%, tools and equipment 20%, mapping 5%, safety and regulations 26%, administration 11%, math 10%). This is the first release size; more questions can be added later at the end of the source files. This is a local content package, not proof of a production import.

CWEAHB: CWEA Collection System Maintenance Candidate Handbook, Version 2025.01 (Grade 1 examination content outline and domain weights)
CWEACSM: CWEA Collection System Maintenance Certification program page
CMOM: US EPA, CMOM Guide for Sanitary Sewer Collection Systems
